{{Quote|We could dress you up as a master chef or a fleet admiral&hellip;but then people would remember you.|Garik Loran to Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Master Chef''' was a title given to beings who demonstrated absolute superiority in the culinary field. The most high-end restaurants of the galaxy sought to employ such [[Chef/Legends|chefs]].<ref name="SOTE">{{WEGCite|story=A Very Special Meal|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Tavvar Va'ran]] held the title of Master Chef of the exclusive [[Manarai]] restaurant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SOTE" />
